review_scope: Exact-hash incremental successor to the v0.9 imagery contract. Oracle Project Jupiter, CyrusOne FRA7, and Colt London 4 inherit the default not-reviewed outcome and add no independent imagery review. No satellite image, aerial image, publisher image, rendered map tile, computer vision, or analyst visual geolocation contributes to identity, lifecycle, construction, capacity, power, energy, efficiency, workload, role, operating model, geometry, building count, progress, or unique-site claims. OSM polygons and the Hessian permit coordinate are structured source records, not imagery review.
